description: Upgrade a Platform-style host from the VM's 0.3.x binary to 0.4.0 and roll it back, with one environment holding both settings sets (OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform next to the explicit bind, port, mutation, instance and OAuth client settings).

inputs.agent: the 0.4.0 release binary built locally from this branch (VERSION=0.4.0-e2e, no tag, no publish), started by the journey with `serve` and explicit settings
inputs.previous: the dev VM's installed 0.3.x Rust release binary (/home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent)

requirements.scenario: A host carrying both settings sets is upgraded from 0.3.x to 0.4.0 with nothing switched: it serves at the same address with mutations admitted, on the same state
Rollback to 0.3.x keeps both settings sets: the old binary reads OPUTE_AGENT_MODE, the new one ignored it, and work done under 0.4.0 is there

requirements.requirement: Every orchestrator is an ordinary client
requirements.scenario: An orchestrator's machine client listed in OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS keeps its generated credential across the upgrade and the rollback

steps.guest: install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/roll /tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-roll --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-roll' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:roll}' --setenv='OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform' --setenv='HOST_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3004' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_INSTANCE=platform' --setenv='OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS=opute-mcp-host' /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3004/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3004/health

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/roll /tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-roll --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-roll' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:roll}' --setenv='OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform' --setenv='HOST_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3004' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_INSTANCE=platform' --setenv='OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS=opute-mcp-host' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3004/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3004/health

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/roll /tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-roll --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-roll' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:roll}' --setenv='OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform' --setenv='HOST_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3004' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_INSTANCE=platform' --setenv='OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS=opute-mcp-host' /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3004/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3004/health

cleanup.guest: python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove roll >/dev/null; rm -rf /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py; true
